context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 48 verified all features. Key findings: 1) JWT expiry: Mobile/native platform gets 365-day token, web gets 30-day. JWT contains 'plt' claim with platform value. 2) Pagination: /cards and /public/cards support skip/limit params. 3) Multiple locations: Card model has 'locations' array field, CreateCardPage has 'Agregar otra ubicacion' button (appears after primary location set), ViewCardPage renders multiple locations. 4) Premium templates: 4 templates (premium_formal, premium_glass, premium_fullimg, premium_animated) with PRO badges in TemplateSelector. 5) Long-press tooltip: On minimized card pills, 400ms long-press shows tooltip with card title + type label. 6) N+1 optimization: Posts feed and for-you feed use batch $in queries for users/profiles/likes/bookmarks.

mobile_jwt_365_day_expiry.details: POST /api/auth/login with platform='mobile' returns JWT with ~365 day expiry. Web platform returns ~30 day expiry. JWT contains 'plt' claim.

cards_pagination.details: GET /api/cards?skip=0&limit=2 and GET /api/public/cards?skip=0&limit=2 return paginated results correctly.

card_locations_field.details: Card model has 'locations' array field. Creating card with multiple locations works. ViewCardPage renders additional locations.

premium_templates_pro_badges.details: TemplateSelector shows 4 premium templates (premium_formal, premium_glass, premium_fullimg, premium_animated) with PRO badges for all card types.

long_press_tooltip.details: Long-press (400ms) on minimized card pill shows tooltip with card title and type label (e.g., 'Test NFC Card· Personal').

n_plus_1_optimization.details: Posts feed and for-you feed use batch $in queries for users/profiles/likes/bookmarks instead of N+1 queries.

multiple_locations_ui.details: CreateCardPage has 'Agregar otra ubicacion' button (appears when primary location is set). ViewCardPage renders multiple locations with data-testid.
